title: CSE versus LET area-level deficiency comparison and Civil Service source-first modernization

comparison.selection_rationale: Civil Service has the larger substantive deficiency: smaller native pool, 34.84% inherited dependence, thinner minimum native concept cohorts, nine concentrated coverage/depth rows, explicit current clerical scope weakness, and lower CSE study/source readiness. LET is deferred because its native pool is broad, inherited dependence is only 7.4%, area repeat risk is lower, and its residual issue is mainly current specialization crosswalk coverage rather than broad native-bank thinness.
comparison.losing_board_deferral_reason: LET remains comparison-ready for Batch 628; it was not expanded because its effective pool is mostly native and its principal deficiency is specialization alignment/reorganization, not the larger repeat/source deficit observed in CSE.

official_area_gaps: current GI/clerical scope needed explicit repository encoding
civil-service.source_gaps: Current official PDF and applied public-service/clerical source chain were incomplete.
civil-service.study_gaps: Existing CSE modules were foundations, not sufficient application derivation for all five areas.
civil-service.blueprint_mismatch: Internal CSE target sections did not explicitly encode the current GI/clerical variant distinction.
civil-service.version_sensitive_debt: Current CSC scope, RA 6713, constitutional, human-rights, and environment application items.

official_area_gaps: current specialization variants are only partially represented
let.thinnest_area: Secondary Specialization / smallest stored subject cohorts
let.source_gaps: Specialization-specific currentness remains a crosswalk issue, not a reason to treat the large native general pool as deficient.
let.study_gaps: Existing LET study chain is materially broader; specialization reorganization is a future need.
let.blueprint_mismatch: Current PRC specialization alignment exceeds the repository’s represented LET subject variants.

civil-service.current_effective_scope: CSC Examination Announcement No. 03 s. 2026 for the 09 August 2026 CSE-PPT; Professional covers General Information, Verbal Ability, Analytical Ability, and Numerical Ability; Subprofessional covers those areas plus Clerical Ability.

General Information.scope: Professional and Subprofessional: Philippine Constitution; RA 6713; peace and human-rights issues/concepts; environment management and protection.

Verbal Ability.scope: Professional and Subprofessional: word meaning, sentence completion, error recognition, sentence structure, paragraph organization, reading comprehension in English and Filipino.

Analytical Ability.scope: Professional and Subprofessional: word analogy, symbolic logic/abstract reasoning, assumptions and conclusions, data interpretation.

Numerical Ability.scope: Professional and Subprofessional: basic operations, number sequence, word problems.

civil-service.future_effective_changes: No later CSE scope amendment was located in the current CSC 2026 announcement/calendar; future CSC examination announcements control.
civil-service.amendments: The 2026 announcement is the answer-critical scope record; it supersedes use of older generic CSE summaries for current scope claims.

let.current_effective_scope: PRC Resolution No. 20 s. 2025 alignment of the LEPT with the revised CHED curriculum, together with Resolution No. 11 s. 2025 TOS and PRC July 2025 alignment guidance; applies to September 2025 and subsequent LEPT schedules.

Elementary General Education.scope: General Education for Elementary examinees; BEEd uses the 40% General Education and 60% Professional Education structure.

Elementary Professional Education.scope: Professional Education for Elementary examinees; BEEd uses 60% Professional Education.

Secondary General Education.scope: General Education for Secondary examinees; current guidance states 20% General Education.

Secondary Professional Education.scope: Professional Education for Secondary examinees; current guidance states 40% Professional Education.

Secondary Specialization.scope: Specialization for Secondary examinees; current guidance states 40% and lists current specialization alignment including PE, CAE, and TLE/TVTEd changes.

let.future_effective_changes: No later PRC amendment changing the September 2025 alignment was located on the current PRC pages; subsequent PRC issuances control.
let.amendments: Resolution No. 20 s. 2025 adds/aligns Elementary Special Needs/Early Childhood and Secondary specialization structures; repository LET content represents only the stored general/professional and existing specialization subjects.
